title: Nearby Chat
description: Limits chat visibility by distance, so players only see nearby messages.
body:
Nearby Chat limits chat visibility by distance, so players only see messages from nearby players instead of the entire server.

This includes regular chat, death messages, advancements, and join/leave messages, with optional per-dimension filtering and operator bypass support. Private messages can also be disabled entirely.

Features:

  • Limits chat to a configurable distance
  • Supports death messages, advancements, and join/leave messages
  • Optional per-dimension filtering
  • Optional operator bypass
  • Can disable /msg, /tell, /w, and team messages

Config preview: chat is limited to 1000 blocks by default, death messages and advancements use separate ranges, join/leave messages have their own range, and private messages are enabled by default.
